decision.title: MIT license; the tinyactors-dev organization and its names (owner)
decision.summary: sxml is MIT licensed, the npm package is @tinyactors/sxml, the repository moves to the tinyactors-dev organization when the owner says so, and Kotlin uses the package dev.tinyactors.sxml.

body.p: on the owner's word: "MIT, we'll move this under the tinyactors-dev organization once done, so the npm package will be @tinyactors/sxml". Settles the open items of , and .

item.p: License: MIT, in LICENSE at the root, copyright "The sxml authors" (the owner may name a holder). Vendored third-party code keeps its own licenses (third_party/*).
npm: the JavaScript package is @tinyactors/sxml (was sxml-js).
Repository: moves to the tinyactors-dev GitHub organization once the owner says so; URLs that name dhamidi/sxml (the grammars' tree-sitter.json) change with the move, not before.
Kotlin and Maven (default under , to match): package dev.tinyactors.sxml, coordinates dev.tinyactors:sxml-android and dev.tinyactors:sxml-jvm; the Swift module stays Sxml. Amends .
